name: The Afrolites
caption: A tag team that issued a standing open challenge for months before finally winning the IWF Tag Team Championship by forfeit when the defending champions failed to answer the bell.

tenures.source: the site's own roster/bio page and show text

name: Neil and Bob
caption: IWF Tag Team Champions who lost the belts to The Afrolites by forfeit after failing to leave their locker room in time for their title defense.

name: The Pocket Protectors
caption: A nerd-gimmick tag team billed out of "The Chess Club," scheduled to face Nemesis on a future card the surviving record never captures.
